_comment: GPT partition layout for target 2 (Chromebook, x86-64, UEFI/MrChromebox). Sizes in MiB; 0 = fill remaining space. Physical order on disk matches array order.

partitions.label: ZIK-ROOT
partitions._note: Mounted read-only in production; remounted rw only during OTA update (P6.6).

partitions.label: ZIK-MAINT
partitions._note: Separate GRUB entry; contains fsck, password-reset, reinstall tools (P6.7).

partitions.label: ZIK-SWAP
partitions._note: Dedicated swap for suspend-then-hibernate (P6.8). Must be >= RAM size.

partitions.label: ZIK-DATA
partitions._note: Fills remaining disk space. F2FS for flash longevity (H.2.11).
